name: setup-next
title: Ultima setup for Next.js App Router
description: PROTOTYPE (ULT-8). components.json, babel.config.js, postcss.config.js and the @stylex; stylesheet. Universal item: installs without Tailwind.
docs: Ultima on Next.js: StyleX compiles through babel.config.js (Turbopack picks it up) and extracts CSS through postcss.config.js. Import app/ultima.css from your root layout, then run: npx shadcn add @ultima/button
